contract.phase_scope: All12 original phases, separate outcome cutoffs; five seeds preserved. Only three disjoint development months enter the descriptive hypothesis screen, never pooled with repeated validation months.
contract.ranking: Original complete closed approval day score DESC/ID ASC, floor(N/10), unknown outcomes compete before known/cohort/group masks. No new alert ranking or quota.
contract.common_misses: Primary same-identity all20-model FN; focus groups also retain every seed own four-model FN. Same on-time controls are reused, not five independent datasets.
contract.strata: Full state_route x promise condition x Monday00:00 approval week x each candidate own history-support bin(s). Week boundaries may cross calendar months but phases never mix.

promise_conditions.promise_bin: Original <=7,(7,14],(14,21],(21,30],>30 calendar days, primary; this is not exact matching within bins.
promise_conditions.promise_days: Exact nonnegative integer calendar promise days sensitivity; same week, support, thresholds and weights.

controls.primary: all known on-time queries in the same stratum, no model-score selection
controls.secondary: other known delayed, excluding the own all20 common-miss cohort

coverage_tiers.finite_overlap: >=1 finite common miss and >=1 finite control per stratum
coverage_tiers.cohort_adequate: >=3 finite common misses and >=5 finite controls, irrespective of local-history support
coverage_tiers.supported: cohort_adequate AND every candidate-specific local history count>=20; unknown keys cannot qualify

contract.coverage_denominator: Always retain all common misses; missing signal/no finite control/low cohort/low local history are disjoint uncovered reasons. All empty/zero-miss strata are retained in target-phase detail.
contract.weighting: Use finite common-miss count per stratum. Standardize control mean to the same composition. Equal-stratum effects are sensitivity summaries, never replacement weights chosen after results.
contract.ordering: Risk-oriented common/control probability: greater risk wins, abs difference<=1e-12 ties contribute0.5. Keep all ties. Average per-stratum ordering by common-miss count, never by number of pairs. Pair totals are not independent samples or a new model AUC.
contract.full_cell_detail: 2018-02/2018-02/evaluation only, ALL/R/A/RA/SP->SC at both promise conditions. All12 phases retain complete summaries, weekly effects and all five seed summaries.

hypothesis_screen.direction: Within a phase/group, bin and exact-day supported mean risk differences and ordering-minus0.5 must all be nonzero with the same sign. All five own-seed summaries at both schemes must have the same direction. Positive and inverse hypotheses both reported; never change sign to pick a winner.
hypothesis_screen.scope: ALL/R/A/RA/SP->SC, separately; same direction in at least2 different development months is a work-screen flag, not significance, gain, automatic feature selection, or deployment approval.

prohibitions: No model loading/replay/fit, new feature engineering, scoring, seed/model choice or original holdout evaluation.
No coarsening routes, widening weeks, changing support/promise bins or reducing thresholds after inspecting sparse coverage.
No p values/confidence intervals from reused pairs/seeds/months; no causal or incremental prediction claim from outcome-conditional profiles.
contract.privacy: Public aggregates and stratum context only; no order/seller identities or row-level score/rank vectors.

hypothesis_screen.interpretation: Predeclared exploratory data/consistency screen only. Passing does not establish significance, causality, incremental model benefit or suitable deployment.

limitations: The same inspected historical/development queries and fixed model misses are reused; matching does not remove model-outcome selection or establish causality.
Within-bin promise/day and within-week approval-time variation can remain. Exact-day sensitivity can be sparse and must not be replaced after inspection.
Supported strata require3 misses/5 controls and local20 history only as fixed work definitions, not power, significance, safety or incremental prediction guarantees.
Five seeds reuse outcomes and controls; repeated validation months retain distinct cutoffs and are not independent replications.
Pair-ordering retains ties and uses miss-count stratum weights; pair totals are not independent samples or new model AUC.
Completed-history, final-status eligibility, exported-attribute and event-time-as-knowledge assumptions remain those of the frozen mature audit.
